channel.title: France 24 - International breaking news, top stories and headlines
channel.description: Breaking news and world news from France 24 on Business, Sports, Culture. Video news. News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America

item.title: Ebola started 3 months earlier than official declaration
item.description: The WHO says that sequencing shows that the fast moving Ebola outbreak in DR Congo started about 3 months before the emergency was officially declared in May. Also, its crunch week for Zambia as voters gear up for elections. And a Rwandan mine has become one of the US's main suppliers of tungsten, a metal critical to the defence industry.
item.dc:creator: Georja CALVIN-SMITH

item.title: Iran-backed Houthis strike Red Sea port of Mocha, threatening shipping routes
item.description: Yemen’s Iranian-backed Houthi rebels struck a government-held port on the country’s Red Sea coast late Sunday, escalating fears over threats to strategic shipping routes and a potential return to civil war.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Russia bars only anti-war party 'Yabloko' from September parliamentary elections
item.description: Russia's Supreme Court on Monday barred the country's only anti-war party, Yabloko (Apple), from running in September's parliamentary elections. About a hundred protesters gathered outside the courthouse chanting, "Shame! Shame!" after the ruling was delivered.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Tensions in the Arctic: Greenland issues sharp rebuke to Trump-linked oil company
item.description: Greenland’s government issued a “strong warning” last week after a new Texas oil company linked to US President Donald Trump moved equipment intended for exploratory drilling ashore without the required approval. Nuuk’s authorities must now walk a tightrope between stabilising relations with the US and resisting Trump’s territorial ambitions.
item.dc:creator: Sonya CIESNIK

item.title: 🔴 Live: At least 47 killed after powerful quake rattles Colombia
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Deadly 7.4-magnitude earthquake strikes western Colombia
item.description: At least 47 people were killed and dozens of buildings collapsed in cities across western Colombia on Monday after a powerful 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck the South American nation.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: In Malaysia, wave of hate speech threatens Rohingya refugees
item.description: The spread of hostile content on social media in Malaysia has intensified tensions towards the Rohingya refugee community, leading to the eviction of more than 100 people from their village and the temporary closure of schools attended by refugee children.
item.dc:creator: The FRANCE 24 Observers

item.title: India: Students clash with police over exam leaks
item.description:
🇮🇳 Thousands of students and unemployed young people have been protesting in Jharkhand since late July, demanding reforms to the state’s recruitment exam system.
The unrest comes after weeks of demonstrations in Delhi that led to the resignation of India’s education minister last month.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Canada: Octogenarian is first killed in British Columbia wildfire
item.description: An 80-year-old woman died in the fast-moving Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia's wine country, ​Canadian police ‌said, after the blaze nearly doubled in size over the ⁠weekend and forced the evacuation of people in the area.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Dolphin: Tropical storm causes some flooding in eastern China
item.description:
Tropical storm Dolphin dumped heavy rain in eastern China on Monday, causing flooding in places after making landfall as a typhoon the previous day.
Authorities have warned of risks of severe flooding and landslides in some areas.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Trial opens for ex-gang leader charged with Tupac Shakur's 1996 murder
item.description: Jury selection is due to begin on Monday in the ​murder trial of an ex-street gang leader accused of masterminding the drive-by shooting death of hip-hop star Tupac Shakur three decades ago in Las Vegas, a long-unsolved crime that became a seminal moment in rap music history.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: 🔴 At least 20 dead after 7.4-magnitude quake hits western Colombia
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: WHO urges Ervebo vaccine trial in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
item.description: WHO vaccine experts on Friday recommended a full-scale human trial of the only existing approved Ebola vaccine to see if it offers cross-protection against a deadly strain spreading in the DR Congo.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Netanyahu says no Gaza withdrawal until Hamas disarms
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu said Sunday that Israel’s military “will not carry out any withdrawal until Hamas is genuinely disarmed.” The White House has not commented on the Israeli Prime Minister’s dismissal of Trump’s deal for Gaza.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Solar Eclipse: Three things we could learn on August 12
item.description:
🌌 Save the date: the first total solar #eclipse visible from mainland Europe in 20 years is set to happen this week!
🌕 🌑 On August 12, the #Moon will completely block out the #Sun during a rare total solar eclipse across much of northern #Spain.
🔭 But while we watch the show, scientists will conduct many experiments.
Julia Rougie explains ▶️
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Ocasio-Cortez says she's freezing her eggs as she decides her next political moves
item.description:
Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez says she is freezing her eggs as she decides her next political moves ahead of the 2028 presidential election campaign.
“This is a choice that I am making to feel more in control of my life,” Ocasio-Cortez, 36, said on Instagram about her decision regarding her reproductive options.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Nearly 70 percent of France under water restrictions amid record heat
item.description: Nearly 70 percent of France is now under water-use restrictions as successive heatwaves and severe drought intensify pressure on the country’s water supplies. Authorities said Monday that 67 of 101 departments had reached the highest crisis alert, while two-thirds of groundwater reserves were below normal levels. Another heatwave is expected to spread across the country this week.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: US: 30 years after Tupac’s murder, trial finally begins
item.description: 🎤 Nearly 30 years after Tupac Shakur was killed in Las Vegas, the case is finally going to trial. The rapper’s death became a defining moment in the East Coast-West Coast hip-hop rivalry of the 1990s, which involved some of the biggest names in rap.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Colombia declares national emergency as quake toll hits 111
item.description: Colombia declared a national emergency on Monday after a 7.4-magnitude earthquake in the west of the country killed at least 111 people and injured 87 others as rescue teams searched for survivors trapped under debris. The quake prompted evacuations in the capital, Bogota, and was felt across other parts of Latin America, including Ecuador and Panama. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: DR Congo: Could a vaccine soon be available to the public?
item.description: The Ervebo vaccine has proved safe and effective against the more common Zaire strain of the Ebola virus, and World Health Organization experts say early data, notably from animal trials, suggest it may also offer some protection against the rarer Bundibugyo strain, which is spreading in the DR Congo. We discuss this with our guest, Dr. Paulin Mutombo Beya, deputy director at the Kinshasa School of Public Health.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: A 7.4-magnitude earthquake shakes Colombia and Ecuador, prompting people to evacuate buildings
item.description: A powerful 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia on Monday, shaking the South American nation and neighboring Ecuador and prompting people to evacuate homes and buildings.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Typhoon Dolphin, "the biggest storm China has seen this year"
item.description: The weakening Typhoon Dolphin brought heavy rain and grounded hundreds of flights on Monday in eastern China, where authorities said more than a million people have been evacuated over the past few days. Our correspondent Jan Camenzind Broomby tells us more
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Russian forces in Syria will give up control of two strategic bases on the Mediterranean coast
item.description: After 18 month talks, Russian forces in Syria will give up control of two strategic bases on the Mediterranean coast, which will be used as joint Russia-Syrian training centers under a new agreement between the two countries.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Ukraine drone strike on Russian oil-refining city kills 12 people
item.description: A Ukrainian drone strike on the central Russian region of Tatarstan killed at least 12 people in one of the deadliest attacks carried out by Kyiv since the war began more than four years ago. The strikes are also directly impacting Russian's economy. Our correspondent Emmanuelle Chaze tells us more.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24
